ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.

input.comment: [Playbook] The cap is currently measured by "Fees", which is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the mutual cap is illusory. We have changed the basis to all amounts paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim, with a USD 1,000,000 floor, per our standard position; Excluded Claims (indemnities, confidentiality, data protection and security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement) remain outside the cap. If the USD 1,000,000 floor is an issue, we can accept a straight 12 months' amounts cap.
input.summary: Replace the illusory "Fees"/first Order Form cap basis with the greater of 12 months' amounts paid or payable and USD 1,000,000.
